info.description: Soundboard server for uploading sounds into channels and playing them back to connected clients.
info.title: Yuri API

get.description: Lists all API keys of the authenticated user. Requires the "read" scope when using an API key.

post.description: Creates a new API key. The raw key is only returned once in the response. Requires the "write" scope when using an API key.
Updates the name of an API key. Requires the "write" scope when using an API key.

delete.description: Deletes an API key. Requires the "delete" scope when using an API key.

post.description: Authenticates the user and sets the "session" cookie.

get.description: Lists all channels the authenticated user owns or is a member of. Requires the "read" scope when using an API key.

post.description: Creates a new channel owned by the authenticated user. Requires the "write" scope when using an API key.
Disconnects the authenticated user from the channel they are currently connected to. Requires the "write" scope when using an API key.

get.description: Returns a channel the authenticated user owns or is a member of. Requires the "read" scope when using an API key.

post.description: Updates the name of a channel. Only allowed for the channel owner. Requires the "write" scope when using an API key.

delete.description: Deletes a channel. Only allowed for the channel owner. Requires the "delete" scope when using an API key.

post.description: Connects the authenticated user to a channel. If the user is connected to another channel, they are disconnected from it first. Requires the "write" scope when using an API key.

get.description: Lists all invites of a channel. Only allowed for the channel owner. Requires the "read" scope when using an API key.

post.description: Creates an invite for a channel. Only allowed for the channel owner. A max_activations of 0 means unlimited activations. Requires the "write" scope when using an API key.

delete.description: Deletes an invite of a channel. Only allowed for the channel owner. Requires the "delete" scope when using an API key.

get.description: Opens a server-sent events stream delivering sound, channel and play events for the authenticated user. Requires the "read" scope when using an API key.

post.description: Adds the authenticated user as member to the channel of the invite. Requires the "write" scope when using an API key.

get.description: Lists all sounds. Requires the "read" scope when using an API key.

post.description: Creates a new sound either from an uploaded file or from a media URL downloaded via yt-dlp. Exactly one of "file" or "url" must be provided. The audio is transcoded to Ogg. Requires the "write" scope when using an API key.

parameters.description: Sound handle (letters, digits, underscores and dashes only)
parameters.name: handle

get.description: Exports all sounds as a .tar.gz archive containing a meta.json and the Ogg encoded sound files. Requires the "read" scope when using an API key.

post.description: Imports sounds from a .tar.gz archive in the format produced by the export endpoint. Sounds with existing handles are skipped. Requires the "write" scope when using an API key.

get.description: Returns the Ogg encoded audio file of a sound. Requires the "read" scope when using an API key.

post.description: Updates the handle and tags of a sound. Requires the "write" scope when using an API key.

delete.description: Deletes a sound and its stored audio file. Requires the "delete" scope when using an API key.

post.description: Creates a copy of a sound with a new handle and tags. Requires the "write" scope when using an API key.
Plays a sound in the channel the authenticated user is currently connected to. When ":random" is passed as ID, a random sound is played. Requires the "write" scope when using an API key.
Trims a sound to the given range. The original audio file is replaced. Requires the "write" scope when using an API key.

get.description: Lists the latest entries of the sound play log ordered from newest to oldest. Plays of deleted sounds are included. Requires the "read" scope when using an API key.

Lists the most played sounds ordered by their play count together with the total number of plays of all sounds. When "since" is given, only plays from that point in time until now are counted, otherwise all time. Plays of deleted sounds are not counted. Requires the "read" scope when using an API key.

parameters.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) or RFC3339 timestamp from which plays are counted
parameters.name: since

total_plays.description: TotalPlays is the number of plays of all sounds in the requested time range.

handle.description: Handle must only contain letters, digits, underscores and dashes.
Handle must only contain letters, digits, underscores and dashes.

ApiKeyAuth.description: API key passed as "Bearer <token>". Alternatively, the "session" cookie set by /auth/login can be used. API keys must have the scope matching the request method: GET requires "read", POST requires "write" and DELETE requires "delete". Session cookies are not restricted by scopes.
ApiKeyAuth.name: Authorization
